# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_SQUEEZE_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
A contracted EMA ribbon signals low volatility; a break above the ribbon with expanding volume captures the imminent volatility expansion move.

## Mechanism
Calculate 8, 21, 34 period EMAs on 5‑min bars; compute ribbon width = max(EMA)-min(EMA). If ribbon width < 0.15*ATR(14) for three consecutive bars and the close exceeds the highest EMA of the ribbon with volume > 1.5*average volume of the prior 20 bars, enter long at the close of the third bar. Exit shape: Initial chart‑stop at the lowest EMA of the ribbon; primary target at 1.5R; remaining half trailed with a chandelier exit (ATR*3) or premium‑stop 20% of entry price. Regime hint: Optimal when VIX < 12 and during the first two hours after the open; avoid high VIX (>20) or scheduled news windows.
